key_facts: Sept. 9, 2026: Plaintiff applied through Indeed for the Night Auditor / Guest Service Agent position at Delta Hotels by Marriott Santa Clara–Silicon Valley (2151 Laurelwood Rd., Santa Clara). Sept. 16: in-person interview with John Barros, who later set Plaintiff's schedules. Sept. 22: written offer ($24/hr Night Audit; $23/hr GSA) and a Universal Background Screening packet on the HMG trade name 'Delta Santa Clara'; the authorization recites separate disclosure documents that Plaintiff never received. Sept. 27: Marriott International, Inc. issued Plaintiff's Marriott Enterprise ID. Oct. 9: Marriott verified him for its Explore associate rate. Night Audit training was assigned to Night Auditor Justin Howell. Oct. 29: Howell's 'He released you didn't he?' remark referring to released sex offenders; the Nov. 1–7 roster cutting overnights from 4 to 3 was posted before that shift and photographed Oct. 30 at 7:03 a.m. Nov. 3: Barros texted that he had 'heard' about Plaintiff's attendance. Nov. 5 at 5:52 p.m.: roster cut to 2 overnights. Nov. 11: Howell told Plaintiff the cuts were because he had been calling out. Nov. 12: Barros issued a written warning reciting only Plaintiff's texts to Howell and said the reductions were 'by design'; at 2:02 p.m. he sent a roster restoring 3 overnights. Plaintiff remains employed.
